Policies and Initiatives.title: Hamirpur’s Dhaaneta college launches AI, data science degrees
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Government Degree College in Dhaaneta, Hamirpur, has introduced B.Sc. degree programs in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data Science, becoming the first government college in Himachal Pradesh to do so. The new courses aim to equip students with skills needed for future technological advancements. The launch is part of the college's efforts to prepare students for emerging technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: AI maps Rs 22,600-crore green gold in Himachal Pradesh forests
Major AI Developments.summary: Himachal Pradesh's forests have an estimated annual economic potential of Rs 22,600 crore, according to a new study. This untapped wealth can help strengthen the state's economy, create rural employment, and enhance climate resilience. The study suggests sustainable resource management can unlock this potential and contribute to the state's growth.

Major AI Developments.title: Himachal: AI-powered scams, deepfake calls pose rising cyber threat
Major AI Developments.summary: Cybercriminals are using AI and psychological manipulation to scam people, posing a rising threat in Himachal. The scammers are employing AI-powered tools, including deepfake calls, to dupe individuals out of their money. The Himachal police have warned people to be cautious when using smartphones and digital platforms to avoid falling prey to these scams.

Major AI Developments.title: AI eyes on roads: Tech-driven policing gains momentum in Himachal
Major AI Developments.summary: The Himachal Pradesh Police has installed Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS) at 75 locations to curb road accidents and enforce traffic rules. The AI-driven system has electronically detected numerous traffic violations, resulting in fines worth several crores. This tech-driven approach aims to strengthen scientific traffic enforcement and reduce accidents in the state.

Major AI Developments.title: Building AI the Indian way: The rise of technology innovation hubs
Major AI Developments.summary: India is rapidly advancing in artificial intelligence, driven by Technology Innovation Hubs that connect research with industry. IIT Mandi's new lab is focusing on multimodal AI, integrating various data types for real-world applications. This initiative aims to create India-specific datasets, fostering technological self-reliance and positioning India as a leader in AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: Himachal Tourism corp inks MoU with AI platform for higher footfall
Major AI Developments.summary: Himachal Pradesh Tourism Development Corporation (HPTDC) has partnered with Adotrip.com to boost tourism in the state. The collaboration integrates HPTDC hotels into Adotrip's AI-powered platform, enabling smart booking and personalized travel recommendations. This partnership aims to increase global visibility, improve hotel occupancy, and promote off-beat destinations in Himachal Pradesh.

Major AI Developments.title: Cybercrime cases spike 52% in a year in Himachal
Major AI Developments.summary: Cybercrime complaints in Himachal surged by 52% in a year, reaching 18,706 in 2025, reflecting a global trend of organized cybercrime. The rise is attributed to the use of AI and various fraud methods by cybercriminals. The police are combating this with dedicated units, awareness campaigns, and financial coordination, urging citizens to be vigilant.

Major AI Developments.title: Himachal Youth Congress protests arrest of workers over AI summit stir
Major AI Developments.summary: Youth Congress members protested the arrest of their workers who demonstrated at an AI summit in Delhi, demanding their release and criticizing the government for suppressing dissent. The protesters also expressed embarrassment over the display of a Chinese robotic dog at the summit. They accused the BJP of hypocrisy in its handling of protests, sparking further controversy.

Major AI Developments.title: Himachal sees surge in cybercrimes, 18,706 complaints in 2025
Major AI Developments.summary: Himachal Pradesh experienced a 52% increase in cybercrime complaints from 2024 to 2025, with 18,706 cases reported. The surge includes AI-driven scams and organized crime, contributing to the rise in complaints. Police are addressing the issue through dedicated units, awareness campaigns, and online safety advice.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-powered traffic systems to curb violations in Himachal’s Nurpur
Major AI Developments.summary: Nurpur police have implemented an AI-powered Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) to enforce traffic rules and issue e-challans. The system includes the installation of CCTV cameras, funded by a Rs 20 lakh grant, to enhance surveillance in areas such as Jassur town. The initiative aims to curb traffic violations and improve overall road safety in the region.
